title: TypeMirror should be compared using Types#isSameType, not equality operators or equals().
summary: Error Prone turns it on by default.

title: Type parameter declaration shadows another named type.
summary: Error Prone turns it on by default.

title: Type parameters must be a single letter with an optional numeric suffix, or an UpperCamelCase name followed by the letter 'T'.
summary: It is an experimental check, so Error Prone does not turn it on by default.

title: Type parameter used as type qualifier.
summary: Error Prone turns it on by default.

title: Type parameter declaration overrides another type parameter already declared.
summary: Error Prone turns it on by default.

title: Declaring a type parameter that is only used in the return type is a misuse of generics: operations on the type parameter are unchecked, it hides unsafe casts at invocations of the method, and it interacts badly with method overload resolution.
summary: Error Prone turns it on by default.

title: TypeMirror#toString shouldn't be used for comparison as it is expensive and fragile.
summary: It is an experimental check, so Error Prone does not turn it on by default.
